question: open-b3
unit: total for the building connection (one new six-unit light industrial building)

band.unit: total for the building connection (one new six-unit light industrial building)
band.basis: One component: Chorus's building-level New Property Development network contribution, scaled from Chorus's own quoted fibre-network charge of $345,600 (GST excl.) for 216 connections to 6 connections (low, $9,600) and to 12 residential-equivalents for light-industrial uplift (high, $19,200). GST exclusive, NZD. Priced as one building-level connection, not six tenant connections. Low confidence: the only published Chorus charge is a different development and Chorus confirms each site by its own quote.

band.unit: total for the building connection (NZD, GST exclusive)
band.basis: Chorus's charge to connect a building is not a published rate - its price list expresses the connection as time and materials at published hourly rates, less the standard contribution of $1,000 per tenancy served. Priced on the assumption the building adjoins existing Chorus fibre and only a building-level connection is required (one charge for the building, not six tenant connections). Total is the sum of the four components, floored at nil because Chorus does not levy a negative charge. Excludes internal cabling and fit-out within the building (out of scope) and excludes any network extension, which Chorus designs and quotes per development. Allowances (materials and hour estimates) carry about a third of the gross, hence low confidence; rates are from the 2011 schedule and current rates are higher, so treat the top of the band as the more likely figure if a non-standard install is triggered.

band.unit: total, Chorus charges to bring fibre to a new six-unit light industrial building (building-level connection; excludes internal cabling and fit-out and excludes six retail tenant connections)
band.centre: Auckland (Chorus wholesale/NPD charges are national, not centre-specific)
band.basis: Component build-up: (1) Chorus development contribution 6 premises x $900 = $5,400 (cited, historical Chorus policy figure); (2) assessed-site uplift allowance $0-$4,200; (3) Chorus non-standard install/excess works allowance $1,000-$3,500. All GST-exclusive. Assumptions priced: charges are per premises for six units with one building-level lead-in; the site is a standard in-footprint infill with capacity at the boundary; civil works, lead-in pipe and reinstatement within the site are the developer's scope and are excluded; six separate tenant retail connection fees (Chorus charges one month's recurring fee per business connection - Price List July 2026, item 1.2, source-2 page 10) and internal reticulation are excluded. QV CostBuilder has no fibre/telecom connection rates, so no QV row is used; QV's nearest rows price internal reticulation ($11/m2) or civil trench/ducts that sit in the developer's scope. Caution: about 60% of the high end is labelled allowance, and Chorus's actual NPD charge is a bespoke portal quotation (POA) - confidence is therefore low, and the band should be treated as a cost-plan range only. An optional Chorus Fibre Project Management charge of $463.61 (Complex location, one charge for the location however many connections share it - Service Description for Fibre Project Management, January 2026, clauses 31.2-31.3) is NOT included; add it only if the building owner/RSP orders FPM.

band.unit: total for the building connection (one new six-unit light industrial building, GST exclusive)
band.basis: ADDED: (1) Chorus development contribution for fibre network reticulation to the building, one building-level premises contribution of $1,600 excl GST (Chorus April 2022 New Property Development quote, 216 connections, $345,600 fibre network = $1,600 each), which is already the whole of the sourced charge and is fixed, not ranged; plus (2) a $0-$1,000 allowance for Chorus POA non-standard install/minor extra works. Low = $1,600; high = $2,600 (midpoint $2,100; $2,600 shown as the point estimate because component 1 is fixed). Note that the allowance is under a third of the low end but about 38% of the high end, so confidence is low. Basis: one new six-unit building, building-level connection only, standard reach with network capacity at/near the boundary, design/materials/supervision/civil for a standard route inside Chorus's contribution. Excluded: internal cabling and fit-out, the per-unit tenant connections, the ISP-side wholesale business new-connection charge (one month's recurring fee, paid by the retailer when a tenant orders), and any job-specific network extension. Chorus quotes every NPD job on application, so this is a cost-plan proxy, not a certified Chorus price.
